description: This file defines the ActionsMenu class, which manages a popup context menu for device actions in a GUI, including creating, activating, and deactivating menu items.

classes.name: ActionsMenu
classes.description: Popup context menu for devices, managing creation and activation of menu items.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the ActionsMenu with a reference to the GUI, retrieves the menu object, and creates menu items.

methods.name: create_menu
methods.description: Creates the popup menu by initializing menu items and connecting signals.

methods.name: activate_menu_items
methods.description: Activates specified menu items by name.

methods.name: deactivate_menu_items
methods.description: Deactivates specified menu items by name.
